title: bug: create_team's name+role idempotency looks up the untrimmed name but stores the trimmed one, so a space-padded --team value mints a new same-named team on every seat launch instead of returning the existing team
description:
Filed by defect hunt #9 (task-66961b32), lane: daemon team tool family. All paths are under packages/moe-daemon/ unless noted.

PROBLEM
- The contract, src/tools/createTeam.ts:11: "Create a team or return existing team with same name+role (idempotent)".
- The lookup uses the raw name: createTeam.ts:57-58 calls state.getTeamByNameAndRole(params.name, ...).
- The store saves the trimmed name: state.createTeam calls validateTeamName (src/state/validators.ts:651-655, trim: true).
- So "Coders " never matches the "Coders" team it created, and every call creates another team with the same name and role.
- Who calls it: the wrappers, on every seat launch and before each claim while the seat is unjoined. They pass --team verbatim: scripts/moe-agent.sh:408-409 sets TEAM="$2", and :2110-2115 sends json.dumps({'name': TEAM}). TOOL_AUDIENCE is [] (src/tools/index.ts:227), so only wrappers and governors call it.
- Impact: with a padded value, each launch creates and joins its own "Coders" team. The fleet splits into one-seat teams and claim_next_task's team sharing is lost; per scripts/moe-agent.sh:2141-2144, a seat without a shared team skips every epic a live worker holds.

EVIDENCE (HEAD 39bec237, run in a git-archive snapshot outside the shared checkout)
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-66961b32/A/zzHuntA_createTeamTrim.test.ts, with its output in .out.txt beside it. The architect re-ran it in /tmp/hunt-6696-snap (verify-architect.txt). Tests 2 failed (2):
  - two create_team {name:'Coders '} calls: received sameId false, secondCreated true, teams ["Coders|null","Coders|null"];
  - create_team {name:' Gov', role:'governor'} after {name:'Gov', role:'governor'}: received created true, sameId false.

FIX DIRECTION
- Normalize the name once before the lookup, e.g. `const name = validateTeamName(params.name)`, and use that value for both getTeamByNameAndRole and state.createTeam.
- Keep missingRequired for an absent name, and keep the existing INVALID_INPUT for a bad type or a name that is blank after trim.

FILES
- src/tools/createTeam.ts
- src/tools/createTeam.test.ts
definitionOfDone: In src/tools/createTeam.test.ts, two create_team {name:'Coders '} calls return the same team id. The second returns created: false, state.teams.size is 1, and the stored name is 'Coders'.

In src/tools/createTeam.test.ts, create_team {name:' Gov', role:'governor'} after {name:'Gov', role:'governor'} returns created: false and the first team's id, while a roleless create with the same trimmed name still creates a separate team.
`cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/createTeam.test.ts src/tools/joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts` passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
